items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: she always calls me [Unintelligible] Hilton‟s husband

ctx.x: So now I am living out here and Basie is out here. Katherine is a very social lady and I am just a bass player. In fact to this very day she always calls me
[Unintelligible] Hilton‟s husband. I wasn‟t into this society at all and Basie wasn‟t either because he was like the salt to the earth. He just wanted cool it.
